title: AI assistants you text: iMessage, WhatsApp or their own app
h1: ai assistants you text: choose the channel and the computer
description: Compare Poke, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Genspark Claw and Metal by messaging channel, setup and what stays running when your laptop is off.
answer: **texting your assistant from the couch should start with the chat app you already open.** poke feels like a contact; it's joining cognition, announced 23 july 2026.[^3] openclaw and hermes connect chat apps to agents you can run. genspark claw offers cloud or local work. dusk has its own app. choose where to text, then which computer stays awake.

review.by: lead agent: independent reviewer pass against seo/facts (4 reviewers), every finding applied, automated gate

og_line: pick the channel, then the computer.

them: **stay beside your contacts.** you want imessage, whatsapp or telegram without another inbox.
**use the channel you already open.** pick a tool whose hosting and setup you are willing to keep running.
**keep one place to talk.** a familiar messaging app matters more to you than a dedicated bot team.
dusk: **give each bot a job.** you want separate names, memories and conversations.
**choose the ai per bot.** switch models while keeping its chats.
**pair to your own machine.** use your computer, server or dusk cloud through the dusk phone browser.

method:
**choose how you want to talk and who keeps it running.** Metal is based on Dusk Bot. we read the product pages and docs on 12 november 2026.

we didn't run identical tasks, time message delivery or test every channel ourselves. use the channel and hosting rows to choose your first trial.

sections.h: if imessage is the requirement, start there
sections.md:
**want a contact in imessage? start with poke or openclaw.** poke lists apple messages, whatsapp, telegram and rcs.[^1] openclaw also lists imessage.[^4] compare their setup and hosting before choosing.

dusk uses its own app. pair its browser version on iphone or android and add it to your home screen. store apps are on the way. the browser version sends no notifications.[^12]

if imessage decides it for you, read the [poke comparison](/alternatives/poke).

sections.h: whatsapp and telegram leave you another decision
sections.md:
**the chat channel is only half the choice.** openclaw, hermes and genspark claw list whatsapp and telegram.[^4][^7][^9]

- [openclaw](/alternatives/openclaw) runs on your machine or server[^4]
- [hermes agent](/alternatives/hermes-agent) adds an optional cloud agent on paid nous plans[^7]
- [genspark claw](/alternatives/genspark) offers a dedicated cloud computer or local desktop mode; connect chat apps under channels[^9]

local mode still needs your computer on. check your model provider's current terms before relying on its sign-in.

sections.h: give the first text a clear boundary
sections.md:
**start with a job you can inspect.** try: "help me plan a weekly review of this project folder. show the schedule first. ask before changing anything."

in dusk, a routine returns a card with next runs, **edit**, **pause** and **undo**.[^15] read it before relying on the timing.

local routines stop when the app closes or the computer sleeps. a miss under 12 hours runs once when you return; older runs skip.[^15]

faq.q: is there an ai agent for imessage?
faq.a: **yes, poke and openclaw list it.** poke hosts the agent. openclaw runs on your machine or server. compare that responsibility before choosing the shared channel.[^1][^3][^4]

faq.q: which ai assistants work in telegram?
faq.a: **openclaw, hermes agent and genspark claw list telegram.** as of 12 november 2026, all offer that channel. choose between their local and hosted routes.[^4][^7][^9]

faq.q: can an assistant text me first?
faq.a: **poke describes proactive messages, reminders and background automations.[^11]** try the trigger and channel you need before relying on that first nudge.
**you talk to dusk bots in their own app.** phone access uses a paired browser version today. store apps are on their way.[^12][^13]
